positions.name: CadenceMandatePerformance
positions.frame: how does a cadence mandate get performed and settled — from authoritative directive through justifying equivalence to recorded ownership?
positions.why: All three expressions participate in the same decision-act: Quinton mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals and frames unrehearsed capability as nonexistent (src-1), the cadence is recorded as operational fact (src-2), and ownership is assigned to Quinton Fairweather (src-3). The set holds tension between the aphoristic urgency of the directive — a constitutive equivalence delivered as creed — and the flat administrative register of the metadata labels, but the frame's read holds both: the decision is performed both as urgent principle and as settled record.
